evidence: The films’ thickness and refractive index were analyzed ex situ by a spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) using a Sentech SE 800 working over the wavelength range of 300–850 nm. The mass density, the roughness, and the film thickness (additionally to SE) were determined by x-ray reflectometry (XRR). The crystal structure, the degree of crystallization, and the crystallite orientation were determined by grazing incidence diffraction (GID) measurements where the incidence angle was set to 1°.
